name: aladdin.colors
description: Canonical Aladdin color tokens. Every surface, ink, border, accent and focus token derives from the four approved palette roots (Deep Navy, Warm Sand, Soft Cream, Muted Terracotta) directly or via color-mix(in srgb); the only other hues are the semantic status tones. Older Aperture primitive names are kept as aliases. Semantic tokens reference primitives via {primitives.<name>}. This file is the source of truth; DESIGN.md frontmatter, frontend/src/styles/tokens.css, and the Tailwind theme mirror it.
maintenance: Manually maintained. On any color change, edit this file first, then propagate to DESIGN.md frontmatter and frontend/src/styles/tokens.css (see tokens/README.md).

ink.description: Alias of deep-navy. Primary text and primary action fill on light.

lumen-soft.description: Alias of terracotta-glow. Accent tone for text and focus on dark.

verdigris-bright.description: Alias of status-success-bright. Success on dark.

ochre-bright.description: Alias of status-warning-bright. Warning on dark.

oxide-bright.description: Alias of status-danger-bright. Danger on dark.

line-dark.description: Alias of sand-line-dark. Hairline border on navy.

on-dark-muted.description: Alias of sand-muted. Muted text on navy.

shell-deep.description: Alias of deep-navy. Foot of the shell ramp.

fg-muted.note: AA on every light ground, including surface-2. Measured by frontend/src/styles/palette-contrast.test.ts.

accent-solid.note: Fills and large marks; about 2.7:1 on surface-2, so never a sole indicator there.
